critical_findings.title: Unbounded Metric Values in Feedback Processing
critical_findings.description: Metric values used in confidence calculations without bounds validation. Allows NaN, Infinity, and out-of-range values.
critical_findings.impact: Invalid metrics propagate through confidence scoring, corrupt pattern evaluation

critical_findings.title: Redis Key Injection via Content ID
critical_findings.description: Content ID used to construct Redis keys before sanitization. Colons in ID can inject into keyspace.
critical_findings.impact: Redis namespace pollution, cross-content data contamination

critical_findings.title: SQL-like Injection via Pattern ID in Feedback History
cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements
critical_findings.description: Pattern IDs not validated before storing in Redis. Special characters in ID corrupt storage structure.
critical_findings.impact: Feedback data corruption, potential deserialization vulnerabilities

critical_findings.title: Command Injection in Shell Script Argument Parsing
critical_findings.description: Content ID parameter used before validation. Shell metacharacters (backticks, $(), semicolons) can execute commands.
critical_findings.impact: Remote command execution if script runs with elevated privileges

critical_findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting and Unbounded Redis Operations
critical_findings.description: Unbounded redis.keys() and lrange() operations without pagination or timeout. Nested loops without iteration limits.
critical_findings.impact: Denial of service through Redis memory/CPU exhaustion

high_findings.title: Insufficient Timestamp Validation
high_findings.description: normalizeTimestamp() accepts future dates without validation. Allows injection of false performance data.
high_findings.impact: False performance metrics corrupt predictive models and decision-making

high_findings.title: URL Validation Bypass - SSRF Risk
high_findings.description: isValidUrl() only checks protocol, accepts localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.x.x (AWS metadata)
high_findings.impact: SSRF vulnerability allows access to internal services and cloud credentials

high_findings.title: Missing Input Type Validation in Parsing Functions
high_findings.description: parseGSCResponse() and parseGA4Response() assume array indices and data types without validation
high_findings.impact: NaN/Infinity propagation, incorrect pattern confidence updates

high_findings.title: Error Information Leakage
cwe: CWE-209: Information Exposure Through an Error Message
high_findings.description: Full error objects passed to error handler. Stack traces expose internal structure and sensitive information.
high_findings.impact: Information disclosure enables reconnaissance for targeted attacks

high_findings.title: Unvalidated Algorithm Update Data
high_findings.description: Algorithm update data loaded from loadRiskDatabase() not validated before use in correlation detection
high_findings.impact: Algorithm correlation false positives, incorrect pattern deprecation decisions

medium_findings.title: Weak Pattern ID Sanitization
medium_findings.description: sanitizeContentId() removes special chars but doesn't validate result length or semantic format
medium_findings.impact: Empty strings possible after sanitization, silent data loss

medium_findings.title: Missing Concurrency Control
cwe: CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization
medium_findings.description: Pattern confidence updates are read-modify-write without atomicity. Race condition in concurrent scenarios.
medium_findings.impact: Lost updates to pattern confidence, convergence failures in feedback loop

medium_findings.title: No Validation of Applied Patterns Array
medium_findings.description: appliedPatterns array items not validated for required fields before processing

medium_findings.title: Shell Script Input Validation Order
medium_findings.description: Variables used before validation (covered more fully by CRITICAL-4)
medium_findings.impact: Invalid data processed by functions before validation

medium_findings.title: No Compression/Size Limits on Feedback History
medium_findings.description: Feedback history stored indefinitely with only soft ltrim(50) limit, no TTL or compression
medium_findings.impact: Redis memory exhaustion, denial of service

medium_findings.title: Type Guard Functions Don't Reject Invalid Numbers
medium_findings.description: Type guards don't use Number.isFinite(), allow Infinity and NaN in calculations
medium_findings.impact: Invalid metrics accepted, Infinity propagation in calculations

medium_findings.title: Batch Processing Lacks Error Recovery
medium_findings.description: No distinction between retriable and fatal errors, no retry logic or backoff
medium_findings.impact: Legitimate failures marked permanent, no resilience to transient errors

medium_findings.title: Missing Validation of JSON Parsing
medium_findings.description: Inconsistent error handling in JSON.parse(), some paths lack try-catch
medium_findings.impact: Application crash on malformed Redis data, DoS

low_findings.title: Missing Deprecation Warnings
low_findings.description: Functions marked as 'real integration structure' but lack deprecation notices

low_findings.title: Incomplete Error Messages
cwe: CWE-209: Information Exposure Through an Error Message
low_findings.description: Error messages for validation failures don't suggest remediation steps

low_findings.title: Missing Logging Context
low_findings.description: Log messages lack correlation IDs for tracing execution

low_findings.title: Missing Performance Metrics
low_findings.description: No instrumentation for function execution time or Redis operation latency

phase_0_immediate.description: Fix critical injection vulnerabilities and metric validation

phase_1_this_week.description: Implement remaining critical/high fixes, comprehensive input validation

phase_2_next_sprint.description: Address medium-priority findings, add concurrency control and error recovery

cases: Invalid metric values (negative, NaN, Infinity, out-of-range)
SSRF URLs (localhost, private IPs, metadata services)
Injection patterns (Redis keys, pattern IDs, shell metacharacters)
